future_registrations.decision_gates: - **Decision gates.** A technical pass requires both versioned records, including hypothesis and origin, timings, input and source identities, matched controls, gross and net results, turnover, trial exposure and coverage by UTC day and band. Report non-overlapping counts and independent-day evidence separately, with dependence and any unavailable effective sample-size estimate explicit. Check future-only perturbation for both candidates and an artificial shared-outcome case that yields no incremental advantage. For the event follow-up, require at least 12 matched pairs across at least four days, with at least four pairs per fold, mean event net return of at least 5 bps and mean paired advantage of at least 2 bps. For the forecast follow-up, require at least a 1% relative MAE reduction against both forecasts in each fold, at least 12 candidate trades across four days with at least four per fold, mean candidate net return of at least 5 bps per trade, and mean incremental net return of at least 2 bps per common eligible opportunity versus the one-feature Ridge policy, including flat decisions. Otherwise record the failed threshold or insufficient coverage and defer follow-up. Keep both results even if neither advances. These screens do not establish independent alpha or M2 acceptance.
future_registrations.definition: - **Candidate `VOL_CONFIRM_V1`.** Hypothesis: unusually high relative volume strengthens short-horizon continuation after a positive five-minute BTCUSDT spot move. At each completed minute `t`, compare `close[t] / close[t-5] - 1` with zero. Among positive events, the candidate adds a filter at the training-only 75th percentile of relative volume among positive events. Reuse the existing definition of current volume divided by the mean of the prior 12 completed minutes. The baseline is the positive-move rule alone, evaluated on the same opportunities. Report actions and skips for both. For the event contrast, take at most one non-overlapping pair per UTC eight-hour band per validation day. In chronological order, match the first eligible high-volume event with the nearest eligible below-threshold positive event in that band, breaking ties by earlier timestamp. Both simulated exits must precede the band end. Freeze the cutoff per fold and count uncovered bands and unmatched opportunities.

At each completed minute use the three existing trailing features and the existing Ridge pipeline. Compare with zero and an otherwise identical Ridge fitted on one-bar return alone.
